rationale.selected_because: The latest event adds an invoice describing supply and fitting one pane, but its amount is blank. This is new document-reported evidence of work, not independent verification; it supports moving the glazing case to completion review, while the unknown invoice total leaves the landlord’s £180-total condition unassessed. The earlier record also says the wider damp/cold concern had no site assessment, so seek authority for an inspection separately rather than treating glazing approval as covering it.

uncertainties: The invoice is a document report, not independent confirmation that fitting occurred; no appointment confirmation or visit report is in the prefix.
The invoice amount is not established, so whether the reported work cost stayed within the landlord’s conditional £180 total is unknown.
The cause and present condition of the reported wider damp/cold concern remain unestablished.
assumptions: The glazing invoice refers to the same kitchen-glazing work described in the earlier quote and approval, based on the matching provider, asset, and work description.

The cold-kitchen and damp reports are treated as one wider concern for inspection planning, as the source itself describes them together; the extracted request IDs alone do not establish separate real-world jobs.
alternatives_considered: Do not close the glazing case yet: move it to completion review, since the fitting is only document-reported and the invoice amount is missing.
Do not request another general work report as a universal prerequisite; the invoice already reports supply and fitting. Seek the specific missing amount instead.
Do not direct inspection of the wider concern under the glazing approval; seek separate landlord authority for that scope.

actions.message: The invoice copy now on file describes supply and fitting of one pane of kitchen glazing, but its amount is blank. We are requesting a corrected invoice; the amount is not yet established, so we cannot assess it against your conditional £180 total approval. The case is being moved to completion review, not marked closed.
